title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Sr. Infrastructure Engineer to own the shared layer that every Harvey IT system runs on. You'll join Core IT Engineering & Infrastructure, reporting to Dave Vega, Director of IT, alongside engineers who own identity and collaboration, Microsoft platforms, networking, and client platforms.

Harvey is cloud-first. We run no servers or data centers of our own. Our IT infrastructure is cloud tenants, SaaS configuration, office networks across a growing global footprint, and the automation that ties them together. Today that cross-cutting work is done on the side by each platform owner. This role makes it someone's primary job, so it gets built once, done well, and doesn't break quietly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own the shared infrastructure, automation and reliability work that cuts across every IT platform.

- IT cloud accounts and tenants. Own access, guardrails and cost for the cloud accounts IT runs (AWS, Azure, GCP projects for IT tooling). Be the BizTech engineering partner to Security and Infrastructure on tenant-level changes, such as cloud migrations that touch Entra and M365.

- Infrastructure as code for IT. Build and run the Git repos, CI pipelines and review process for IT configuration (Okta, Jamf, Intune, Google Workspace). Platform owners keep owning their config. You own the framework they all use.

- IT automation and provisioning. Own the automation behind identity lifecycle and IT workflows: SCIM and provisioning flows, onboarding and offboarding orchestration across systems, and IT workflows in Serval.

- Monitoring, backup and resilience. Set up health checks and alerting for critical IT systems and integrations, config drift detection, SaaS backup (Google, Slack, M365) and tested recovery runbooks.

- Scripts and internal tooling. Take over the scripts and admin utilities that live on individual laptops today. Put them in source control, document them and keep them running.

- Office site standard. Work with Network and AV/Media teams to define the repeatable technical template for new offices: configuration, monitoring and documentation each site copies. Network and AV build execution stays with their owners.

- Engineering practices. Raise the bar on change control, documentation and runbooks across the pillar, so primaries and backups can cover for each other.

- Certificates, domains and DNS. Track and renew every certificate IT depends on (Apple Push, SAML signing, SSL, Wi-Fi/802.1X). Work with Network and CorpSec teams to own and manage DNS NS solutions for IT. Build expiry monitoring to avoid surprises.

WHAT YOU HAVE

Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 

Position Summary and Responsibilities
KBR is seeking a Systems Engineer to support the development, evaluation, and implementation of a Verification and Validation (V&V) Analysis Tool supporting NASA mission activities. • Review verification and validation artifacts for completeness, consistency, and compliance.
• Assess alignment between requirements, verification methods, and verification results.
• Participate in technical reviews, stakeholder meetings, and working groups.
• Evaluate tool outputs against mission expectations and document findings.
• Maintain engineering repositories, technical records, and project documentation.
• Support configuration management and technical baseline control activities.
• Prepare technical reports, briefings, status updates, and engineering recommendations.
Required and Preferred Qualifications, Education, and Experience
Minimum Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline.
• 5-8 years of systems engineering experience.
• Experience supporting requirements development, management, or analysis.
• Knowledge of systems engineering lifecycle processes.
• Experience supporting verification and validation activities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Requirements
• Experience supporting NASA, FAA, DoD, or other federal programs.
• Master's degree in Systems Engineering or related discipline.

title: Senior Business Risk Analyst
description:
Crisis24 AiiA is seeking a Senior Business Risk Analyst with deep expertise in corporate risk and financial analysis to assess complex business and financial risks. This role will combine subject matter expertise with advanced analytical capabilities, including the use of AI to accelerate and enhance risk analysis, evaluate emerging trends, and assess how geopolitical, economic, financial, financial, operational, regulatory, and security developments may impact client organizations.
What You Will Do:
Own the end-to-end development of AI-enabled corporate risk assessments, including prompt engineering, assessment methodology, testing and validation, and final delivery. Continuously refine AI outputs to ensure accurate, relevant, and actionable risk intelligence for clients. Assess corporate risk across geopolitical, economic, financial, operational, regulatory, reputational, and security dimensions, identify exposure and forecast emerging threats and opportunities.
Leverage AI capabilities and AI-enabled platforms to conduct analysis at speed and scale: synthesizing large and disparate data sets, surfacing signals, modeling exposure, and stress-testing analytic judgments.
Employ AI to produce a full range of intelligence analysis products, including executive briefings, threat and financial-risk assessments, country and market-entry assessments, risk forecasts, and bespoke research.
Collaborate with analysts, subject-matter experts, and platform/technology teams to refine intelligence outputs, strengthen AI-assisted workflows, and improve analytic tradecraft.
Maintain analytic objectivity, sourcing rigor, and quality standards across all products, including appropriate human oversight of AI-generated outputs.
What You Will Bring:
Bachelor's degree (Economics, Finance, or Business is preferred). Minimum of 7 years of experience assessing business and financial risk intelligence analysis products. Demonstrated expertise with both corporate risk and financial analysis methodologies, including risk assessment frameworks and financial/economic analytic techniques. Hands-on experience using AI capabilities and AI-enabled tools to conduct analysis-for example, to process large data sets, generate insights, or accelerate the production of analytic products-paired with sound judgment in validating AI-generated outputs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex risk and financial analysis clearly to senior, non-specialist decision-makers. Proven ability to work under deadline pressure while maintaining accuracy and analytic integrity.
Preferred Qualifications
Professional credentials or formal training in financial analysis or risk management (e.g., CFA, FRM, or equivalent). Advanced degree and/or deep experience with corporate risk and financial analysis.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) C-UAS
description:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description

This is a forward-deployed engineering role . You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes- the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments- and lead the software integration of modular Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) sensors and effectors. You will deploy, harden, integrate, and operate our modular C-UAS solution.

Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero , not always on a plane . Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement genuinely calls for it - initial standup, in-SCIF integration work, on-the-ground incident response, training, and knowledge transfer- and you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero the rest of the time. The job is being their engineer, not living at their desk.

You are a cross-functional engineering leader. You can take responsibility for the full breadth of a data and software integration platform- make it work where it has to work, analyze what's running through it, and solve problems in real time for the mission hero. About 20% of your time, you'll also help make Defense Unicorns' forward-deployed team better - pairing with junior Data Engineer FDEs on hard problems, helping them develop technical judgment, and raising the ceiling on what the team can take on.

Responsibilities

•
Deploy and harden UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment - stand up UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required.

•
Own integration with existing mission systems - connect UDS Data Capability to existing infrastructure, including sensor arrays, computer-vision-enabled UAS interceptors, and a broad range of C-UAS solutions.

•
Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries - ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions.

•
Operate what you deploy - own initial day-2 operations, including capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Transition ownership to the mission hero's operations team once stable.

•
Generate accreditation artifacts - STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings to support ISSM/ISSO requirements in IL4/IL5 environments.

•
Represent the mission hero to product and engineering - document issues, write postmortems, recommend operator improvements, and communicate field challenges to the platform engineering team.

•
Train and transfer knowledge - develop runbooks, architecture documentation, working sessions, and knowledge-transfer materials that enable mission teams to operate independently.

•
Mentor junior Data Engineer FDEs - pair on complex problems, review integration designs, and help engineers develop technical judgment without direct people-management responsibilities.

Clearance & Travel

•
Clearance: Active TS/SCI required.

•
Travel: Approximately 10%-25%, based on mission and customer requirements.

•
On-site expectations: Ability to work in SCIFs and other restricted environments for days or weeks when required for integration, incident response, training, or knowledge transfer. Most work is performed remotely.

Required Qualifications

• Experience working in tactical edge and interoperable mission environments, including TAK Server administration, ATAK/WinTAK, tactical communications, and disconnected or air-gapped systems.

• Production experience with modern data platforms, including lakehouse technologies (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi), object storage (Ceph or S3-compatible), PostgreSQL, and analytical query engines

title: Director - Payor Relations - Regional
description:
PURPOSE OF JOB
The Director, Payer Relations - Regional is responsible for developing and executing regional payer engagement and coverage strategy for the TearCare® System. The role builds sustained relationships with Medicare Administrative Contractors, regional commercial health plans, Blue Cross and Blue Shield plans, Medicaid organizations, integrated delivery networks, and other healthcare decisionmakers to advance appropriate patient access and establish clear, evidence based coverage policies.
This leader translates national Market Access priorities into focused regional plans, leads payer discussions regarding TearCare clinical evidence, coding, coverage, and payment, and coordinates cross-functional resources to address policy barriers. The Director serves as the regional payer-relations lead and is accountable for developing engagement plans, monitoring policy activity, preparing coverage submissions, and communicating actionable payer insights to executive and commercial leadership.
MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute a regional payer-relations strategy for TearCare aligned with Market Access, commercial, clinical, medical, legal, and compliance priorities.

• Prioritize regional payer organizations based on patient impact, policy opportunity, access barriers, provider needs, and business priorities; maintain account-specific engagement and coverage plans.

• Build and maintain professional relationships with payer medical directors, policy leaders, reimbursement teams, provider-relations leaders, pharmacy or technology assessment committees where applicable, and other economic decisionmakers.

• Lead compliant payer meetings and discussions focused on TearCare clinical evidence, patient population, treatment pathway, coding, coverage, payment, health-economic considerations, and provider experience.

• Monitor existing and emerging payer coverage policies, medical policies, clinical criteria, technology assessments, coding edits, prior-authorization requirements, and reimbursement practices affecting TearCare.

• Develop and coordinate payer coverage submissions, reconsideration requests, evidence dossiers, policy comment letters, and follow-up responses using approved clinical, economic, coding, and reimbursement materials.

• Engage Medicare Administrative Contractors and other government payer stakeholders within the assigned region regarding coverage, coding, payment, claims experience, and provider-access barriers in accordance with applicable requirements.

• Partners with Medical Affairs, Clinical, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Regulatory, Legal, and Compliance to identify evidence needs and ensure payer communications are accurate, balanced, appropriately substantiated, and compliant.

• Convert payer feedback and policy trends into clear recommendations for evidence generation, publication strategy, value messaging, reimbursement tools, provider education, and account prioritization.

• Coordinate with Field Reimbursement Managers and Sales leadership to identify regional access barriers, distinguish account-level reimbursement issues from payer-policy issues, and establish appropriate escalation and follow-up pathways.

• Provide payer-policy interpretation and strategic guidance to internal stakeholders while avoiding guarantees of coverage or payment and preserving payer-specific nuance.

• Create executive-ready regional updates that summarize payer engagement, policy status, open barriers, opportunities, risks, decisions needed, and next actions.

• Represent Sight Sciences at payer meetings, medical society discussions, healthcare policy forums, and other relevant external engagements as assigned.

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation of payer interactions, policy milestones, commitments, evidence requests, and follow-up actions in approved company systems.

• Manage regional payer-relations projects, external consultants, budgets, and deliverables as assigned;

WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is redefining what’s possible in legal work by combining cutting-edge AI with intuitive product experiences. As we scale rapidly and take on increasingly complex use cases, we’re expanding our product engineering team to accelerate our ability to ship fast, delight users, and build infrastructure that scales with us.

Agents at Harvey let lawyers turn their expertise into reusable, automated work: custom agents and workflows that draft, review and analyze across a firm’s documents. The Agents team owns Agent Builder, the Agents experience, workflows and the foundations underneath them: orchestration, durable execution, permissions and reliability. Other Harvey products build on this platform as well.

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead a large, senior team of full-stack and backend engineers through the shift from single-turn assistants to long-running, multi-agent systems that firms trust with their most sensitive work. This role is equal parts product judgment and systems depth.

WHY NOW

- Agents are how firms put Harvey to work: lawyers are turning their expertise into reusable agents and workflows that run across their documents and matters.

- The work is moving from single-turn assistance to long-running, scheduled and multi-agent work. That demands durable execution, sandboxed tools and recovery from failure at scale.

- Agents now reach deep into a firm’s most sensitive data, so permissions, tenant isolation and governance have to hold everywhere an agent can act.

- Other Harvey products are building on this platform, so its quality and speed set the pace for much of the company.

- We need a leader who can raise the bar on reliability and evaluation while the team keeps shipping quickly.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Lead the Agents engineering team, a group of senior full-stack and backend engineers building Agent Builder, the Agents experience, workflows and the runtime underneath them.

- Own reliability and quality for agent and workflow execution, including on-call health, incident follow-through, SLOs and evals as part of how the team ships.

- Set technical direction for orchestration, durable execution and agent composition, and stay close enough to the code to make sound architecture calls and unblock hard problems.

- Hold a high bar on security and customer data boundaries, so permissions, isolation and admin controls are designed in from the start rather than patched later.

Buscamos un/a Arquitecto/a IAM / Identity Developer de nivel N3 para definir la estrategia corporativa de gestión de identidades y accesos, diseñar arquitecturas de seguridad y desarrollar integraciones complejas con aplicaciones, directorios y plataformas cloud.

🛠️ Requisitos imprescindibles

• Experiencia: entre 5 y 8 años en proyectos IAM, con experiencia real en implantaciones corporativas.

• Arquitectura IAM: diseño de arquitecturas de identidad, modelos de acceso y estándares de integración.

• Identity Governance (IGA): RBAC, ABAC, segregación de funciones (SoD), Access Reviews, Role Mining, Birthright Access e Identity Analytics.

• Plataformas IAM: experiencia con ISIM/ISVG y soluciones de gestión de identidades.

• Access Management: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, federación, Passwordless y Adaptive MFA.

• Integración y desarrollo: APIs REST, JSON, XML y conocimientos de Java o Python. Se valorarán JavaScript, PowerShell y SQL.

• Directorios e identidad corporativa: Active Directory, LDAP, Microsoft Entra ID, ADFS, Google Workspace y entornos híbridos.

• Seguridad y accesos privilegiados: CyberArk, PAM, Zero Trust, PKI y gestión de secretos.

• Cloud: experiencia con Azure, AWS o GCP.

• Gobierno y cumplimiento: conocimientos de NIST e ISO 27001.

• Liderazgo: experiencia liderando proyectos IAM corporativos y capacidad para definir y presentar un roadmap tecnológico a perfiles ejecutivos.

🧩 Responsabilidades principales

• Diseñar y evolucionar la arquitectura IAM corporativa.

• Definir modelos de autorización RBAC/ABAC, políticas de acceso y estándares de identidad.

• Diseñar integraciones complejas entre aplicaciones, directorios y proveedores de identidad.

• Establecer estándares de autenticación y federación mediante SAML, OAuth 2.0 y OIDC.

• Liderar migraciones desde ADFS hacia proveedores de identidad modernos.

• Diseñar y mejorar los procesos Joiner, Mover, Leaver (JML) .

• Implantar y evolucionar procesos automatizados de certificación y revisión de accesos.

• Identificar riesgos IAM, revisar controles de seguridad y participar en auditorías.

• Definir la estrategia y el roadmap IAM a tres años, alineados con las necesidades de negocio y seguridad.

• Coordinarse con CISO, CIO, CTO y otros stakeholders para presentar propuestas de arquitectura y evolución tecnológica.

⭐ Competencias valoradas

• Arquitectura empresarial y visión estratégica.

• Liderazgo técnico en entornos corporativos complejos.

• Capacidad para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones técnicas.

• Comunicación y presentación de propuestas a perfiles ejecutivos.

Working at Atlassian

title: Cloud Engineer

About Us

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

About The Role

The Cloud Engineer role is critical to scaling Chess.com 's infrastructure to support millions of daily chess games and serve global users. This position combines site reliability engineering expertise with cloud infrastructure management, directly impacting system performance, reliability, and scalability across Chess.com 's multi-regional distributed architecture. The role requires deep technical expertise in both infrastructure automation and application optimization to maintain Chess.com 's position as a high-traffic gaming platform while enabling rapid feature development and deployment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

•
Architect and optimize cloud-native infrastructure using Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitOps tools to support millions of concurrent chess games across multiple global regions

•
Lead performance optimization initiatives by analyzing Golang and TypeScript codebases to identify and resolve bottlenecks at scale, with specific focus on chess programming optimizations

•
Design and implement multi-regional resilient systems capable of handling extreme scale challenges including managing 1 million+ CPUs across dozens of regions

• Run and evolve our private Kubernetes cloud on bare-metal: a Rancher-managed fleet in our own datacenters that carries compute and IO intensive workloads, operated as one platform with GKE regions, with workloads placed wherever they get the best cost and performance.

•
Execute incident response and operational excellence serving as primary technical resource for critical infrastructure issues, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal downtime

•
Develop high-performance integration patterns for distributed systems handling extensive data volumes while maintaining reliability and scalability targets

•
Collaborate with development teams to implement cloud service integration best practices and optimize application deployment architectures

•
Implement Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform to manage all cloud resources, ensuring consistent, automated, and scalable deployment processes

•
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitOps approaches using tools like ArgoCD to enable rapid, reliable software delivery

•
Monitor and enhance system observability through implementation of modern monitoring stacks including Prometheus, Mimir, ES, Vector and Tempo

Qualifications

•
7+ years of experience managing large-scale, cloud-native distributed systems with proven ability to handle high-traffic production environments

•
Expert-level proficiency with Kubernetes including cluster deployment, management, and advanced orchestration patterns

•
Advanced Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform for managing complex cloud and Kubernetes resources in production

•
Strong programming skills in Golang with demonstrated ability to optimize high-performance services and troubleshoot complex codebases

•
Deep understanding of distributed systems design including failure modes, architectural principles, and data modeling strategies

•
Extensive experience with major cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) including advanced services, networking, and cost optimization

•
Proficiency with GitOps and CI/CD methodologies using modern deployment automation and continuous integration practices

•
Hands-on experience with observab

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

 

You’ll drive pricing and packaging for our Sales Assist business. As Sales Assist becomes a larger part of Notion’s growth, we need a deliberate approach to pricing through increasingly complex customer journeys. As Notion takes a strong product and brand further up market, you’ll shape how we connect customer value to pricing for B2B and Enterprise customers. Your days may move from a Product discussion to a CRO presentation to a systems-focused meeting, turning GTM insight into investments EPD can act on.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

- Establish a coherent pricing and packaging perspective for Sales Assist that connects Self Serve pricing, customer value, and the needs of B2B and Enterprise customers.

- By your 90th day:

- Articulate the Sales Assist pricing-and-packaging narrative and the decisions it should guide.

- Deliver a preliminary 18-month pricing and packaging roadmap, grounded in expected business impact and clear prioritization.

- Use AI to monitor market trends, validate proposals, and surface business shifts that could change pricing and packaging decisions.

- By the end of your first year:

- Lead the GTM workstream for at least one pricing or packaging initiative, from recommendation through launch and impact assessment.

- Establish a repeatable market-calibration and ROI feedback loop between GTM and EPD, raising the standard for how future investments are evaluated.

SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

- Track record of leading successful launches, starting with initial ideation, operationalization, and post launch analysis that allows us to tie bets with business outcomes.

- Exceptional communication, executive presence, and commercial judgment-the role requires influencing Sales, Product, EPD, and senior leadership through complex decisions.

- Ability to develop pricing recommendations using quantitative analysis, customer and seller research, market signals, and pricing experiments.

- Curiosity and practical AI fluency: you use AI as a collaborator to analyze signals, test assumptions, validate proposals, and make the team’s work easier to build on.

- Experience with B2B SaaS & AI Product Pricing, including Enterprise Offerings.

- 12+ years experience with Pricing & Packaging.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $280,000 per year.

DotCom builds the web experiences that introduce OpenAI’s research and products to the world. We bring together engineering, design, content, and production to make complex technology clear, useful, and engaging. Our work spans OpenAI.com https://openai.com/, product storytelling such as the ChatGPT overview https://chatgpt.com/overview/, and interactive experiences such as OpenAI Progress https://progress.openai.com/.

For businesses exploring AI, these experiences help connect new capabilities to real needs. We’re hiring a software engineer to take dedicated ownership of B2B web experiences on DotCom. You’ll shape ambiguous projects, make thoughtful technical and design tradeoffs, and own delivery from the first prototype through launch and iteration. You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 7+ years of frontend and/or full-stack software development experience, with an emphasis on building polished web products and integrating APIs.

- Strong frontend fundamentals in JavaScript, CSS, and browser behavior, with experience building and evolving reusable component systems.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, design, marketing, and engineering teams.

- Deep care for quality, functionality, and the people using your work, with attention to every detail-from visual interactions and accessibility to the last page request.

- Innate curiosity and strong product judgment: you ask critical questions, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into clear, useful experiences.

- Enjoyment of working quickly, with the initiative to navigate ambiguity, unblock collaborators, and own projects from prototype through launch and iteration.

- Experience with B2B products, web growth, experimentation, or conversion optimization is a plus.

- Experience with React or Next.js, or with high-traffic, localized websites, is helpful; strong web fundamentals and the ability to learn matter most.

title: Resident Accounts Manager
description:
The Resident Accounts Manager will be responsible for day-to-day operations and financial functions of a portfolio of properties. This remote position centralizes rent collection, delinquency efforts, and scheduled billing responsibilities to optimize revenue for each property. This position also provides resident account support through customer care inquiries until issue is resolved.
Who You Are:

• You are self-motivated and enjoy working with others through a remote office setting with virtual communication

• You have a high degree of self-discipline

• You are dependable, focused, detail-oriented, and take pride in your work.

• You understand the impact that revenue, delinquency, and ancillary income has on the financial performance of the property and portfolio.

• Your work ethic is strong, and you enjoy working with different management styles.

What You’ll Do:

• Collecting and posting rent and other charges in a timely manner according to state and local requirements for each property; review scheduled billing monthly

• Execute collections strategies to keep delinquency below 1%

• Monitor and follow up on bad debt, including use of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to assist with resident communication and collections or in partnership with a third party collections partner

• Preparation of all notices, resident, and guarantor contact, and filing evictions electronically, if available.

• Manage LEAP (or comparable guarantor waiver) accounts; file claims in a timely manner and track payment from the vendor

• Complete pre-close and AME checklists

• Complete monthly damage liability waiver insurance reconciliation

• Post all charges for quarterly inspections and move-out

• Complete timely Final Move Out statements and quarterly notices

• Work closely with collections agency(s)

• Participate in recurring meetings with Regional and Property Managers, as needed, to communicate financial performance of each property in portfolio

• Assist with customer care issues related to resident accounts

What You'll Need:

• Previous experience in an Assistant Manager or Bookkeeper role in the property management industry

• Proficient in Entrata

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of Applications

• Communication skills that foster an environment of connection and belonging, teamwork and productivity

• Ability to create a respectful sense of urgency with rent collections

• Impeccable attention to detail and strong organization skills

• Experience in collecting delinquent rent and post move out charges

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including grammar and punctuation

• Above average negotiating skills

• Ability to handle customer issues to completion

• A high school diploma or equivalent

description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a skilled Senior SoC Architect at Black Semiconductor to drive the architecture of our entire Electronics-Photonics IC (EPIC) SoC, translating the Marketing Requirement Document (MRD) into a complete, internally consistent, and implementable Product Requirement Document (PRD) covering digital, analog, I/O, and memory subsystems.

You will own the digital and high-speed I/O subsystem architecture directly, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet. Working closely with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, memory subsystem owner, product management, and engineering teams, you will integrate their subsystem architectures into one coherent overall product architecture.

- Own the overall EPIC SoC technical leadership from initial concept through production and drive cross-functional technical alignment across photonics, analog, digital, technology, and product teams.

- Build and document the overall product architecture, translating the MRD into a complete PRD and ensuring architectural decisions, technical requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs are consistently aligned across teams.

- Own the digital subsystem architecture, including core logic, on-chip interconnect fabric, and subsystem partitioning.

- Own the high-speed I/O subsystem architecture, with particular depth in high-speed SerDes and the protocol digital logic for UCIe, PCIe, and Ethernet, including how protocol layers map onto the physical SerDes implementation.

- Partner with the Analog/RF System Architect, Photonics System Architect, Package Electrical/SI Architect, and memory subsystem owner to integrate their architectures and ensure the full-chip architecture is internally consistent and feasible within the target electrical, physical, and packaging constraints.

- Drive full-chip performance, power, and area (PPA) trade-off analysis, partner with external vendors/3rd-party IP providers on full-chip validation and characterization teams on product characterization, and make the calls needed to keep the PRD internally consistent.

- Present the integrated architecture and PRD to product management and engineering leadership and own it through to sign-off.

Your Qualifications

- 7-10 years of experience in SoC or product architecture roles, with proven SoC/product architecture ownership and demonstrated experience taking a product from MRD-level requirements through a complete, implementable PRD-level architecture covering multiple subsystems and at least one full product architecture cycle.

Finance & Accounting - Finance & Accounting Prudential is seeking a customer-focused Billing Case Worker to join our Group Insurance Billing organization. This role is ideal for a motivated professional who can manage complex premium billing and accounting activities while delivering a responsive, industry-leading client experience.

Supporting Premier and National Accounts, the Billing Case Worker serves as an end-to-end owner of the billing experience. You will help ensure premium accuracy, timely cash application, effective receivables management, prompt inquiry resolution, and strong financial and customer outcomes.

The team
You will join the Group Insurance Billing team within Service Operations, who support approximately 3,000 active customers and nearly $6 billion in premium. The team plays a critical role in premium administration, financial accuracy, accounting health, and the overall customer experience.

The role
You will manage an assigned book of business across the billing lifecycle, including premium billing, cash application, account reconciliation, inquiry resolution, and performance objectives related to accounts receivable, suspense, and quality. Success requires financial acumen, disciplined follow-through, sound judgment, clear communication, and a strong customer and control mindset.

Key responsibilities

• Own day-to-day billing relationships for assigned complex clients, overseeing premium activity, outstanding balances, account status, and timely follow-up.

• Process and validate accounting transactions, including distributions, disbursements, vouchers, and debit and credit memos, in accordance with established controls.

• Reconcile account activity, identify discrepancies, and resolve complex billing, cash application, receivables, and suspense issues in partnership with internal and external stakeholders.

• Although most of the work is through email communications, you will be required to also lead professional on-camera discussions with clients and brokers, explaining account activity, clarifying actions, and driving issues to resolution.

• Monitor recurring payment issues and account trends, document insights, and contribute to root cause analysis, control enhancements, and process improvement.

• Analyze year-end statements to support ERISA-related reporting and customer needs.

• Guide new and existing customers on Prudential’s billing practices, payment expectations, and available service channels.

• Meet service, quality, and account management expectations by following established procedures, maintaining accurate documentation, and applying industry-aligned billing practices.

Qualifications

• 2-3 years of experience in accounting, premium billing, accounts receivable, cash application, or a related financial operations discipline; general ledger and Group Insurance knowledge are preferred.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, service commitments, and detailed financial work in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex billing matters clearly to clients, brokers, distribution partners, and internal stakeholders.

• Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to make progress through ambiguity.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with the ability to pass a skills-based Excel assessment.

• Ability to investigate and resolve questions from brokers, clients, and distribution partners with minimal guidance.

• Strong time management, organization, relationship management, and follow-through.

• Demonstrated ability to resolve complex issues independently, apply sound judgment, and escalate risks or exceptions appropriately.

title: People Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Our People Team is searching for a People Operations Specialist. You will play a pivotal role in keeping the employee lifecycle running smoothly across Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. You make sure contracts, payroll and employee data are right, and you are a go-to person for managers and employees on everyday HR questions. Reporting to the Head of People Ops, you will join a team that supports 325+ Mossers across 6 offices.

Your responsibilities

- Core people operations: Own the employee lifecycle end to end, from onboarding and offboarding. Create and maintain employment contracts, amendments and templates for our locations in Germany, the Netherlands and the UK, and manage employees hired through Employer of Record (EoR) partners. Make sure every step is documented and compliant.

- Payroll: Prepare payroll inputs, coordinate with our payroll providers and EoR partners, and make sure changes are processed accurately and on time across all locations.

- Supporting managers and employees: Be the first point of contact for HR questions, including probation, performance management, leave and terminations. Apply employment law of the relevant country and know when to escalate complex cases.

- Employee data & reporting: Keep employee data accurate and secure in our HRIS (Personio), in line with GDPR. Work with data from HR reports to spot trends and define follow-up actions.

- Process improvement: Document HR processes and policies in Confluence, identify manual steps and friction points, and implement improvements.

- Benefits administration: Administer employee benefits such as pension schemes, health and fitness benefits and the learning budget, and coordinate with providers across our locations.

- AI & Tooling: Contribute to making us faster by leveraging existing AI workflows and helping us build new ones (Claude, n8n).

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role:

- Solid People Operations experience in a high-growth, fast-paced, international environment.

- Strong execution skills in core HR operations, with hands-on experience in employment contracts and payroll preparation.

- Strong German, UK, and NL labor law knowledge.

- Experience with an HRIS, preferably Personio.

- Demonstrated use of AI tools across daily recruiting workflow (a big plus if you're the one building them).

- Fluent in English and German (C1 minimum).

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

- Reliable executor: you deliver contracts and payroll inputs accurately and on time, and you care about getting the details right.

- Proactive problem solver: you ask questions, use data to find the root cause and take action without waiting to be asked.

- Trustworthy and credible: you handle sensitive data and situations with full confidentiality and build relationships based on a desire to help and support.

- Adaptive communication: you bring structure and clarity to how you present information, and you adjust your style from new joiners to senior leaders.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets

Lyft Ads’ vision is to build the largest transportation media network. We leverage media to elevate the transportation experience for our riders while building an exciting and sustainable advertising business. • Experience managing client and agency relationships directly and owning a book of business.

• Proficient in Google Suite products, particularly Google Sheets and Drive.

• Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.

• Outstanding attention to detail.

• Comfortable managing multiple campaigns across the full ad lifecycle at once, with minimal oversight.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations for sales teams and clients.

• Self-motivated and proactive in finding new solutions before being asked.

Über FION
Die europäische Industrie verliert an Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, weil Strom hier teurer und volatiler ist als in den USA oder China.
Der Grund: Erneuerbare Energien schwanken stark - Fabriken verbrauchen konstant.
Wir lösen dieses Ungleichgewicht: Wir planen und installieren für jeden Standort das passende Batteriesystem und steuern es mit KI in Echtzeit über Tarife und Märkte.
Das Ergebnis: Deutlich niedrigere Energiekosten und messbare CO₂-Einsparungen.
Wir gewinnen Vertrauen, indem wir Systeme liefern und transparent betreiben.
Wir arbeiten bereits mit mehreren Industrieunternehmen zusammen und werden von Early-Stage-Investoren unterstützt.
Deine Rolle
Du übernimmst ab „Deal gewonnen“ und sorgst dafür, dass beim Kunden ein technisch sauberes, sicheres und termingerechtes Batteriespeicherprojekt entwickelt wird.
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgaben

Projektleitung:

Projekte ab Vertragsunterschrift bis Inbetriebnahme führen - Termine, Qualität, Kosten im Blick, zentrale Ansprechperson für den Kunden.

Technische Umsetzung:

Aufbau, Anschluss und Einbindung des Speichers mit Elektrofachbetrieben, Tiefbauern, Herstellern, Anlagenzertifizierern und Kundenteams koordinieren.
Einlinienschaltbilder (SLD) und Messkonzepte verstehen und mitdenken, technische Anforderungen (Anschlusskonzept, Schutz, Sicherheit) sicherstellen.

Netzanschluss & Behörden:

Anmeldungen bei Netz- und Messstellenbetreibern vorbereiten und einreichen.
Rückfragen des Netzbetreibers aktiv steuern, technische Antwortpakete bündeln.

description:
Head of Rewards & Benefits - (Denmark or UK)

Location: Denmark or UK

Type: Permanent

Team: Part of the wider People & HR team (~30 globally). You'll work closely with Finance, HR Operations, and Data & Analytics, as well as senior leadership and country managers

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, commercially minded, hands-on Senior Reward Manager to take the next step in their reward career.

You'll own the delivery of reward across our rapidly scaling, PE-backed, international consulting organisation.

The foundations are in place. We've completed our country analysis, written our reward framework, and gathered the market data to build on. Now we need someone to roll it out and make it work in practice.

You'll work directly with the CPO, Finance and country leaders to keep reward consistent across regions while respecting local market needs.

A particular focus is sales incentives and commission structures for client-facing talent. We also place importance on Management Incentive Plans (MIP). If you've done strong reward work under a senior leader and you're ready for more ownership and visibility, this is your chance.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Incentives & Reward Delivery

- Design and refine quota-based commission and bonus structures for client-facing teams.

- Help build a consistent sales incentive approach across geographies, while keeping our commercial edge.

- Roll out our reward framework: salary ranges, career pathways and benefits structures across countries.

- Support Management Incentive Plans and variable pay design.

Compensation & Benefits

- Run central compensation planning, including the salary review and bonus processes.

- Lead benefits reviews through central brokerage.

- Make sure we stay ahead of EU pay transparency requirements.

- Bring newly acquired businesses onto our reward models, fairly and consistently.

- Partner with Finance on reward budgeting, forecasting and PE reporting. Look at the full cost to company (pay, bonus, benefits and social costs) and show the impact and return of reward decisions.

- Work with external partners such as benchmarking providers, payroll and benefits vendors.

Analytics & Insights

- Use our data to give leadership clear, timely reward insights.

- Build scalable, proactive processes that replace reactive, tactical fixes.

Collaboration

- Work with Operations and Finance to keep reward operations running smoothly, including light support on systems where needed.

- Partner with business partners and leaders to keep reward up to date locally.

- Influence stakeholders across diverse cultural contexts.

About You

You bring experience from the following:

- M&A-heavy organisations, with hands-on experience of harmonising reward after acquisitions.

- Sales compensation-heavy environments (e.g. consulting, recruitment, telecoms), ideally designing quota-based commission programmes.

- PE-backed businesses, with exposure to PE reporting.

You also bring:

- Experience of compensation planning and EU pay transparency.

- Benchmarking experience with providers such as Mercer or WTW.

- A commercial, data-driven mindset and comfort with ambiguity.

- Experience with HR and payroll platforms integrations (a bonus).

- A good understanding of the consulting model.

- Experience of a private equity (PE) transaction is a plus, but not essential.

What We Offer

- A competitive package and the chance to take the next step in your reward career.

- Ownership of delivering a reward framework that's built and ready to roll out.

- Exposure to a PE-backed growth story, with real influence on how we scale.

- Close working with the CPO and senior leaders.

- A chance to help harmonise reward across countries and functions.

- Based in Denmark or the UK.

title: Mid DevOps Engineer (B2B)

ScrapingBee is a developer-first web scraping API that turns a hard technical problem into a simple request. It's built for developers and small teams who want reliable data without becoming scraping experts themselves.
The team behind it stays curious and fast-moving, and its small size means every person's work reaches a global developer community directly.
The team waiting for you:

Our Infrastructure Team is responsible for operating a highly robust platform running across Google Cloud and bare-metal environments that processes massive volumes of web data daily. In this role, you will add immense value by managing Kubernetes clusters, infrastructure as code, and deployment automation to ensure continuous service reliability. As our large-scale distributed workloads continue to expand, this is a critical time to join us in scaling and refining our underlying systems. Ultimately, you will tackle the core challenge of providing rock-solid stability and performance for our infrastructure, all while receiving continuous mentorship and growth opportunities within the team.
In this role, you will:

• Operate and troubleshoot GKE and k8s clusters, actively managing everything from node health and networking to application deployments.

• Provision and maintain infrastructure using Terraform, Terragrunt, and Ansible.

• Build and improve Helm charts, Argo CD ApplicationSets, and GitHub Actions workflows for seamless delivery.

• Investigate incidents using logs, metrics, and health checks, and execute safe changes with clear validation and rollback plans.

• Enforce secure access to GCP services, secrets, and container registries, maintaining a security-first approach to production changes.

• Work directly with developers to troubleshoot issues and improve the overall stability and performance of our systems.

Your skills & experiences:

• Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes workloads, backed by solid fundamentals in Linux servers, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS.

• Practical experience managing infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible, including reviewing infrastructure plans and managing changes across environments.

• Proficiency with Helm, Git-based delivery, and Docker container build pipelines, along with confidence in writing Bash and Python scripts.

• Working knowledge of GCP-particularly GKE, IAM, and Secret Manager - paired with a security-conscious approach to credentials and access permissions.

• Clear communication skills during code reviews and incidents, demonstrating the ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and explain technical trade-offs.

Nice to have:

• Experience with large-scale, multi-cluster systems.

• Experience with web-scraping environments.

• Experience with any of the following: Cloudflare, HAProxy, ArgoCD, Linkerd, Redis, PostgreSQL, Datadog, or VictoriaMetrics.

• Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, NodeJS, Rust, or Go.

• "Don't meet everything above? Apply anyway. We're looking for what's next, not what's already been done."

•
Gross salary: 18 000 pln/month - 23 000 pln/gross. Keep in mind that we are open to discussing a different salary based on your skills and experience.

•
Growth & Learning: 40+ internal learning options, external conferences, mentorship, and year-round knowledge-sharing.

Celebration & Community: Team events, an overseas workation and plenty of ways to mark milestones together.

Sales Administrator - Wizards of the Coast

Wizards of the Coast (‘WotC’) is one of the world's largest publishers of adventure games, including Magic: The Gathering® Trading Card Game and Dungeons & Dragons® Roleplaying Games. Hasbro SA, which is based in Delemont, Switzerland, sells WotC products in Europe through its distributor Hasbro European Trading BV (‘HET’). WotC Europe is part of Hasbro European Services and is based in Stockley Park, UK, providing services to HET.

Job Overview

We’re looking for a Sales Administrator to join our fast-paced, growing Wizards of the Coast Hobby Sales team, helping make sure customers have the information and assets they need for every Magic: The Gathering and Dungeons & Dragons release.

Your job will be to support the Distribution and Direct to Retail (DTR) Sales team across various tasks, which may include preparing and sending communications, price lists, and assets to customers, tracking orders, participating in meetings, and assisting the Sales department wherever possible. You will take direction from the team and also work independently when needed. If you are organized, detail-minded, and enjoy supporting customers and colleagues, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every qualification listed.

Location and Work Arrangement

This role is based in Stockley Park, Uxbridge, UK. We follow a hybrid working pattern, with Tuesday to Thursday in the office and Monday and Friday flexible.

description:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here - and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

Want to help law enforcement agencies find the networks behind organised crime, fraud and money laundering? We're looking for an EMEA lead for our Law Enforcement solutions. You'll lead the development and growth of this sub-industry within our Government sector, working with law enforcement agencies around the world.

Investigators work from intelligence spread across case systems, financial reports, open sources and large volumes of documents. Links between people, companies, accounts and events stay hidden, and cross-border cases stall.

That's the problem we solve, at scale. We resolve that data into entities and networks, so analysts and investigators see who is connected to whom and can act faster, with evidence they can stand behind.

You'd lead this from our Product team, which sits where the market meets the product. You'll report to our VP Government Solutions. Complex problems, senior audiences, real public impact. Ready?

What you'll be doing.

- Own the Law Enforcement proposition across EMEA - the positioning, the messaging and the agencies we go after - and turn what you hear in the market into requirements that shape our EMEA roadmap.

- Make sure it works - keep one set of Law Enforcement decks, demos, blueprints and playbooks in line with the released product.

- Drive adoption of our newest investigation capabilities - such as turning unstructured reports and documents into entities and networks - with agencies and partners.

- Be our senior expert worldwide - support Sales and Field Engineering on the opportunities that matter, as a trusted advisor to senior government stakeholders.

- Build our voice in the market - thought leadership, industry events, analyst briefings and client roundtables.

- Team up with Marketing and Sales - on campaigns, competitor analysis, business cases and the enablement that helps our teams and partners sell with confidence.

- Grow the ecosystem with Alliances - develop the technology, data and delivery partnerships that give us scale, differentiation and pipeline around the world.

- Bring the field back into Product - decide which field work becomes product, and work with R&D to keep the solution ahead.

What success looks like.

In your first 6 months:

- Law Enforcement proposition, messaging and priority agencies agreed for each region and in use by Sales and Field Engineering.

- One current set of Law Enforcement material that matches the released product.

- First market appearance as our EMEA Law Enforcement voice (an event, a paper or an analyst briefing).

By 12 months:

- A measurable contribution to Law Enforcement pipeline and wins across EMEA.

- A recognised voice in the market, with [n] customer or partner proof points we can use.

- Field Engineering and our main partners able to sell and demo the Law Enforcement solutions without you.

description:
ABOUT TEBI

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to build and run the systems behind Tebi’s revenue engine, from how we find and win merchants to how we onboard, retain and grow them across seven European markets.

You’ll apply skills like building enrichment flows, tracking buying signals, setting up outbound and automating workflows in HubSpot and the tools around it across the customer lifecycle, from lead enrichment and outbound to onboarding handover, customer health and expansion. You’ll report to our RevOps Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, Account Management and the Data team.

This is a hands-on role where speed matters. You’ll build with Clay, HubSpot, n8n, APIs, webhooks and AI, and take every idea from first experiment to a system the whole go-to-market team relies on. You understand what drives revenue, so you know what is worth building, and you work in short loops: ship fast, measure, learn and adapt quickly.

What You’ll Do

Build the acquisition engine

- Build enrichment flows, ideal customer profile scoring and lead routing that turn raw leads into clear next actions for reps in HubSpot.

- Design and automate signal tracking across the funnel, including walk-in activity in emerging markets not yet visible in HubSpot.

- Build outbound plays and sequencing systems for sales-led and PLG motions, and run experiments to learn how best to reach customers.

- Prototype and improve an AI outbound assistant that saves reps time, with a human in the loop.

Build the processes and automation behind onboarding, retention and expansion

- Design and automate the Sales-to-Onboarding handover process across our toolstack, replacing manual steps and setting milestones, ownership and service levels from signed to live, with alerts when a merchant stalls.

- Set up the retention signals and risk alerts that matter, each routed to a clear action and owner.

- Design the expansion framework from scratch for sales-led (Account Manager-led) and PLG (automated, in-product or lifecycle) upsell, and build the plays, sequences and automation behind it in our toolstack.

- Measure and refine these processes against pipeline, retention and expansion outcomes, and talk to reps, Account Managers and merchants about their pain points to turn what you learn into better workflows and systems.

- Build and maintain the integrations across our toolstack, including HubSpot, BigQuery and the enrichment and outbound tools, and document system logic so it scales with the team.

What You’ll Need

- Around 3 or more years of relevant experience in RevOps, sales operations or customer success operations, or an equivalent role in B2B SaaS.

- Hands-on experience building enrichment flows, signal tracking and outbound systems.

- Experience in high-velocity SaaS or an agency.

- Good knowledge of Clay and other GTM tools, such as n8n, Make, Apollo, Instantly or similar, and comfort working with APIs and webhooks.

- Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond admin work: workflows, lifecycle stages, properties and reporting.
